notes: Single-fault injections on the legal illustrative golden placement (A(0,0) B(2,0) C(0,2) D(8,4) fixed, E(0,4) F(10,0)). 'expect' lists the semantic outcome every implementation must produce. 'def' says how the mutant is written for OpenROAD; 'openroad' is what OpenROAD check_placement is expected to report, or why it cannot see the fault.

mutants.name: y between rows
mutants.openroad_scope: OpenROAD tests the full rectangle, so the off-row C also hits E above it; our checker reports the same pair as a RECT_INTERSECT diagnostic, not as OVERLAP

mutants.name: right edge one unit outside (anchor inside)
mutants.zh: 锚点在内，右边缘出界一格

mutants.name: full containment
mutants.zh: 窄单元完全落在宽单元里

mutants.name: moved fixed cell
mutants.openroad_scope: check_placement has no reference placement, so it cannot know D moved (scope difference)

mutants.name: duplicate id
mutants.openroad_scope: the DEF reader rejects or merges the duplicate before the checker runs

mutants.name: missing cell
mutants.openroad_scope: UNPLACED F sits at (0,0) inside OpenROAD, so it also collides with A; our checker stops at validation

mutants.name: NaN coordinate
mutants.openroad_scope: DEF coordinates are integers; NaN cannot be written

mutants.name: empty placement
mutants.openroad_scope: every cell UNPLACED; same artefact as M10

mutants.name: unknown cell
mutants.openroad_scope: a DEF component needs a declared master; an undeclared cell cannot be written

mutants.name: wrong orientation (DEF only)
mutants.openroad_scope: orientation is outside the toy model; this OpenROAD version's check_placement does not check it either (see docs/oracles.md)

mutants.name: one DBU over the die edge
mutants.zh: 超出芯片边缘 1 个数据库单位

mutants.name: overlap on an off-row pair (diagnostic only)
mutants.zh: 离行单元与他人相交（只作诊断）
mutants.openroad_scope: OpenROAD reports the C/E rectangle hit as Overlap; ours reports it as a RECT_INTERSECT diagnostic
